description: A switch_ branch whose output dictionary has gained a KEY but not yet a VALUE. Formerly an accepted deviation (issue #810 item 6.1) filed under the no-change-means-no-tick ruling on the reading that the output TSD was empty. It is not empty: released hgraph reports len_ == 1 and a key_set delta adding 'b'. The delta renders as {} only because the single entry has no value to report, so the ruling never applied -- the key set changed. hgraph now installs the key when the key arrives and the two AGREE. The recipe is kept to pin that agreement; its known-divergence entry is gone.
